liveApiKeyCatalog.credential: existing REST API key; not OAuth host verification

name.description: The name of the artist to be created

account_id.description: The account ID to create the artist for. Only required for organization API keys creating artists on behalf of other accounts. If not provided, the account ID will be resolved from the authenticated API key.

active_conversation_id.description: The ID of the room/conversation to copy for this artist's first conversation. If not provided, use the active_conversation_id from the system prompt.

organization_id.description: The organization ID to link the new artist to. Use the organization_id from the system prompt context. Pass null or omit for personal artists.

history.description: Days of follower snapshots to attach per social (max: 90); omitted → none

artistId.description: The artist's account ID to update socials for.

urls.description: An array of social profile URLs to associate with the artist. The platform will be inferred automatically.

catalog_id.description: The unique identifier of the catalog to query songs for. Get this from the select_catalogs tool.

criteria.description: The search criteria or theme to filter songs by (e.g., 'Halloween party songs', 'workout music', 'romantic ballads')

songs.description: Array of songs to add to catalog(s)

catalog_id.description: Catalog ID to which the song will be added. Get this from the select_catalogs tool.

isrc.description: Song ISRC to associate to the catalog

account_id.description: The account ID to filter chats for.

artist_account_id.description: Filter chats to those whose owning session is in the specified artist context (matches `sessions.artist_id`). Composes with `account_id`.

chat_id.description: Array of chat IDs to compact into summaries.

prompt.description: Optional custom prompt to guide which details are retained in the summary.

artistId.description: The artist_account_id to add the knowledge base to. If not provided, check system prompt for the active artist_account_id.

knowledgeBaseText.description: Text to add to the knowledge base

contents.description: The contents of the TXT file

prompt.description: Text prompt describing the image to generate

account_id.description: The UUID of the account to generate the image for.

prompt.description: Text prompt describing the image to generate

account_id.description: The UUID of the account to generate the image for.

imageUrl.description: URL of the image to edit

active.description: Whether pulse is active for this account

country.description: ISO country code for regional results (e.g., 'US', 'GB')

query.description: The search query (e.g., 'Mac Miller concert', 'Wiz Khalifa album cover'). Be specific for best results.

limit.description: Number of images to return (1-100, default: 8).

imageSize.description: Image size: 'l' (large, recommended), 'm' (medium), 'i' (icon/small). Leave unset if unsure.

imageType.description: Type of image: 'photo' (default, recommended), 'clipart', 'lineart', 'animated'. Leave unset if unsure.

aspectRatio.description: Aspect ratio filter. Only use if specifically requested. Leave unset for general searches.

prompt.description: Text description of the video to generate

seconds.description: Duration of the video in seconds (default: 4, max: 20)

video_id.description: The video ID returned from generate_sora_2_video tool (e.g., 'video_123')
The video ID returned from generate_sora_2_video tool (e.g., 'video_123')

include_groups.description: Comma separated values of album types: album, single, appears_on, compilation

prompt.description: The instruction or prompt to be executed. Should not include schedule related instructions for this task.

schedule.description: Cron expression for when the task should run

artist_account_id.description: UUID of the associated artist account

model.description: Optional AI model id for this task. If omitted, the default model is used.

timezone.description: Optional IANA time zone (e.g. America/New_York) the cron schedule is interpreted in, DST-aware. Defaults to UTC. Stored on the Trigger.dev schedule (the source of truth), not persisted on scheduled_actions.

account_id.description: Optional: Filter tasks by the account ID which created them.

artist_account_id.description: Optional: Filter tasks by the artist account ID.

enabled.description: Optional: Filter tasks by their enabled status

id.description: Optional: Filter tasks by task ID

timezone.description: Optional IANA time zone the cron is interpreted in (DST-aware). Applied to the Trigger.dev schedule; a timezone-only change re-syncs the schedule.

id.description: UUID of the task to delete

runId.description: The unique identifier of the task run to check.

audio_url.description: URL to the audio file (mp3, wav, m4a, webm)

artist_account_id.description: Artist account ID for file storage

title.description: Title for the transcription (used in filename)

message.description: The message to send to the team

active_account_email.description: The email of the active account

active_conversation_id.description: The ID of the active conversation

active_conversation_name.description: The name of the active conversation

timezone.description: Optional IANA timezone like 'America/New_York'. If omitted, server local timezone is used.

messages.description: Array of messages for the research query

role.description: The role of the message sender (user, assistant, system)

to.description: Recipient email address or array of addresses

cc.description: Optional array of CC email addresses. active_account_email should always be included unless already in 'to'.

text.description: Plain text body of the email. Use context to make this creative and engaging.

html.description: HTML body of the email. Use context to make this creative and engaging.

headers.description: Optional custom headers for the email

room_id.description: Room ID to include in the email footer link. Use the active_conversation_id from context.

artistId.description: The artist_account_id to update. If not provided, check system prompt for the active artist_account_id.

image.description: (Optional) The new profile image URL for the artist.

name.description: (Optional) The display name for the artist.

instruction.description: (Optional) Custom instructions for the artist's account.

label.description: (Optional) The label or role for the artist.

knowledges.description: (Optional) Array of knowledge objects ({ url, name, type }) to be stored as the knowledge base or notes for the artist. The 'type' field must be a valid MIME type (e.g., 'text/plain' for TXT files).

type.description: MIME type of the file, e.g., "text/plain" for TXT files, "application/pdf" for PDFs

artist_account_id.description: Artist account ID from the system prompt of the active artist.

startDate.description: Start date for revenue data in YYYY-MM-DD format. Example: '2024-01-01'. If not provided, defaults to 30 days ago.

endDate.description: End date for revenue data in YYYY-MM-DD format. Example: '2024-01-31'. Should be after startDate. If not provided, defaults to yesterday.
